# Configuration reference

## Project file (`agentbox.yaml`)

Loaded by every CLI command (`--config`, `$AGENTBOX_CONFIG`, or `./agentbox.yaml`); see [configuration.md](configuration.md).

### `ProjectConfig`

`agentbox.yaml`: model profiles plus sandbox/agent/reward/generation defaults.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default_model` | str \| None | `None` | Profile used when no --profile / --model is given. |
| `models` | dict[str, EndpointConfig] | `{}` | Named model profiles (ModelConfig fields). |
| `sandbox` | SandboxConfig \| None | `None` | Sandbox defaults. |
| `agent` | AgentConfig \| None | `None` | Agent loop defaults. |
| `rewards` | list[RewardSpec] \| None | `None` | Reward components (default: verifier + agent penalties). |
| `teacher` | EndpointConfig \| None | `None` | Model that generates and judges tasks. |
| `students` | list[EndpointConfig] | `[]` | Models benchmarked by `bench run` without --model. |
| `generate` | GenerateSection | `GenerateSection()` | Task generation defaults. |
| `extra` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Unknown top-level keys, kept for tools and plugins. |
| `path` | Path \| None | `None` | File the config was loaded from. |

## Runtime configuration

Python objects behind the project file sections; also accepted directly by `Rollout`, `ParallelRunner`, `AgentBoxEnv` and the trainer integrations.

### `SandboxConfig`

Container lifecycle and environment settings.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | str | `'python:3.12-slim-bookworm'` | Image sandboxes start from. |
| `workspace_dir` | str | `'/workspace'` | Directory holding the task files; tool paths are relative to it. |
| `working_dir` | str | `'/workspace'` | Default cwd for commands. |
| `env` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Environment variables set in every sandbox. |
| `limits` | ResourceLimits | `ResourceLimits()` | CPU, memory, process and network limits. |
| `security` | SecurityConfig | `SecurityConfig()` | Capabilities, privileges, user, runtime. |
| `auto_pull` | bool | `True` | Pull the image when it is missing. |
| `auto_remove` | bool | `True` | Remove sandboxes after each rollout (False keeps every sandbox). |
| `keep_on_failure` | bool | `False` | Keep the sandbox when a rollout does not succeed (for debugging). |
| `labels` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Extra Docker labels on every sandbox. |
| `command` | list[str] | `['sleep', 'infinity']` | Container main process; it only has to keep the container alive. |
| `ensure_pytest` | bool | `True` | Guarantee pytest is importable. Missing pytest is installed once per image into a cached derived image (not per container). |
| `shell` | list[str] \| None | `None` | argv prefix for string commands; default: bash -c if present, else sh -c |
| `max_output_bytes` | int | `262144` | Bytes of stdout/stderr kept per stream (head + tail) for each command. |
| `kill_output_bytes` | int \| None | `67108864` | Kill a command once it has produced this many bytes of output. |
| `prepare_network` | bool | `True` | Allow network while building cached images (pytest / setup snapshots). |
| `cache_setup` | bool | `True` | Snapshot task setup_commands into cached images reused by later rollouts. |
| `cache_max_images` | int | `64` | LRU bound on cached setup images. |
| `warm_pool` | int | `0` | Pre-started containers kept ready per sandbox shape (image, limits, env); each is used by one rollout only. 0 disables the pool. |
| `warm_pool_ttl_s` | float | `300.0` | Idle pooled containers are removed after this long. |

### `ResourceLimits`

Docker resource constraints for a sandbox.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpu_count` | float \| None | `1.0` | CPUs (fractional; None: no limit). |
| `memory_mb` | int \| None | `512` | Memory limit in MiB (None: no limit). |
| `pids_limit` | int \| None | `256` | Maximum processes in the container (fork-bomb guard). |
| `network_disabled` | bool | `True` | No network inside sandboxes (network_mode=none). |
| `memswap_mb` | int \| None | `None` | Memory + swap limit in MiB; default memory_mb (no swap). |
| `shm_size_mb` | int \| None | `None` | /dev/shm size in MiB. |
| `nofile` | int \| None | `None` | Open-file ulimit (soft = hard). |
| `read_only_rootfs` | bool | `False` | Mount the root filesystem read-only (pair with tmpfs). |
| `tmpfs` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Mount path -> tmpfs options, e.g. {'/tmp': 'size=256m'} |

### `SecurityConfig`

Container hardening applied to every sandbox.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cap_drop` | list[str] | `['ALL']` | Linux capabilities dropped. |
| `cap_add` | list[str] | `['CHOWN', 'DAC_OVERRIDE', 'FOWNER', 'FSETID',...` | Capabilities added back after cap_drop (package managers, kill). |
| `no_new_privileges` | bool | `True` | Block privilege escalation through setuid binaries. |
| `init` | bool | `True` | Run an init process as PID 1 (reaps zombies, forwards signals). |
| `user` | str \| None | `None` | Run commands as this user, e.g. '1000:1000' (default: image's). |
| `runtime` | str \| None | `None` | OCI runtime, e.g. 'runsc' (gVisor) |

### `ModelConfig`

OpenAI Chat Completions client config (any compatible server).

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | str | **required** | Model id sent to the server. |
| `base_url` | str \| None | `None` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1. |
| `api_key` | str \| None | `None` | API key (prefer api_key_env; keys never reach trajectories). |
| `api_key_env` | str \| None | `None` | Read the API key from this environment variable. |
| `temperature` | float \| None | `0.7` | None: server default. |
| `max_tokens` | int \| None | `4096` | Completion token budget per turn. |
| `max_tokens_param` | 'max_tokens' \| 'max_completion_tokens' | `'max_tokens'` | Request field name (OpenAI reasoning models: max_completion_tokens). |
| `top_p` | float \| None | `None` | Nucleus sampling. |
| `seed` | int \| None | `None` | Sampling seed (per-sample seeds derive from RolloutConfig.seed). |
| `stop` | list[str] \| None | `None` | Stop sequences. |
| `presence_penalty` | float \| None | `None` | OpenAI presence penalty. |
| `frequency_penalty` | float \| None | `None` | OpenAI frequency penalty. |
| `top_k` | int \| None | `None` | vLLM/SGLang sampling (extra_body) |
| `min_p` | float \| None | `None` | vLLM/SGLang sampling (extra_body) |
| `repetition_penalty` | float \| None | `None` | vLLM (extra_body) |
| `timeout_s` | float | `120.0` | Per-request timeout. |
| `max_retries` | int | `4` | Retries for 429/5xx/timeouts/connection. |
| `retry_backoff_s` | float | `1.0` | Exponential backoff base (full jitter; honours Retry-After). |
| `retry_max_backoff_s` | float | `30.0` | Cap on a single backoff. |
| `adaptive_max_tokens` | bool | `True` | When prompt+max_tokens exceeds the context, retry with the room left. |
| `min_completion_tokens` | int | `128` | Below this much room the context counts as exhausted (policy failure). |
| `capture_tokens` | bool | `False` | Request token ids (vLLM return_token_ids) for exact RL training data. |
| `capture_logprobs` | bool | `False` | Request sampler logprobs. |
| `top_logprobs` | int \| None | `None` | Alternatives per token when capturing logprobs. |
| `record_raw` | bool | `False` | Keep the raw choice dict per turn. |
| `strip_think` | bool | `False` | Move <think>...</think> from content into reasoning. |
| `tool_choice` | str \| dict[str, Any] \| None | `'auto'` | OpenAI tool_choice (None: omit the field). |
| `parallel_tool_calls` | bool \| None | `None` | Forwarded as the OpenAI parallel_tool_calls request field when set. |
| `extra_headers` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Extra HTTP headers on every request. |
| `extra_body` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Merged into the request body, e.g. {'chat_template_kwargs': {...}}. |
| `require_tool_calling` | bool | `True` | Fail fast when the server rejects tool definitions (native protocol). |

### `AgentConfig`

Agent loop and tool selection settings.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tools` | ToolMode \| list[str] | `'structured'` | Tool mode (structured\|extended\|shell\|custom) or a list of tool names. |
| `custom_tools` | list[Any] | `[]` | BaseTool instances or @tool functions to add. |
| `builtins` | bool | `True` | Include the builtin tools of the mode. |
| `system_prompt` | str \| None | `None` | Replace the system prompt ({workspace_dir} is substituted). |
| `max_steps` | int | `40` | Maximum model turns per episode. |
| `step_timeout_s` | float | `120.0` | Budget for one turn (model call, then its tool calls). |
| `episode_timeout_s` | float | `900.0` | Wall-clock budget for the whole episode. |
| `parallel_tool_calls` | bool | `True` | Run consecutive read-only tool calls of one turn concurrently. Calls that write or execute always run sequentially in emission order. |
| `tool_timeout_s` | float | `120.0` | Upper bound for any tool call. |
| `max_tool_output_chars` | int | `16000` | Tool results shown to the model are truncated head+tail. |
| `tool_protocol` | 'native' \| 'hermes' | `'native'` | native: OpenAI tool_calls. hermes: tools rendered into the system prompt and <tool_call> blocks parsed from content (servers without tool parsing). |
| `tool_response_role` | 'tool' \| 'user' | `'tool'` | hermes protocol only: send tool results as role=tool or wrapped user turns. |
| `salvage_tool_calls` | bool | `True` | native protocol: parse <tool_call> blocks the server's tool parser left in the content (e.g. invalid JSON) instead of ending the episode. |
| `drop_tools` | list[str] | `[]` | Tool names to remove. |
| `drop_tools_prob` | float | `0.0` | Drop each tool with this probability per rollout (at least one stays). |
| `include_thinking` | bool | `True` | Record model reasoning in the trajectory. |
| `send_reasoning` | bool | `False` | Echo recorded reasoning back to the server on later turns. |
| `step_penalty` | float | `0.0` | Reward subtracted per step. |
| `timeout_penalty` | float | `0.0` | Reward subtracted on timeout. |
| `max_steps_penalty` | float | `0.0` | Reward subtracted when max_steps is reached. |

### `RolloutConfig`

Full configuration for a single rollout or parallel batch.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandbox` | SandboxConfig | `SandboxConfig()` | Sandbox settings. |
| `model` | ModelConfig | **required** | Policy model endpoint and sampling. |
| `agent` | AgentConfig | `AgentConfig()` | Agent loop and tools. |
| `rewards` | list[RewardSpec] \| None | `None` | Weighted reward components; default: verifier + AgentConfig penalties |
| `seed` | int \| None | `None` | Run seed (per-sample sampling seeds and tool dropout derive from it). |
| `run_id` | str \| None | `None` | Run id (default: random per runner). |

### `RewardSpec`

One weighted reward component; the rollout reward is the weighted sum.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | str | **required** | Registered reward name, or 'module:function' / 'module.fn'. |
| `weight` | float | `1.0` | Multiplier applied to the component. |
| `params` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Keyword arguments for the reward factory. |

## Task schema

`task.json` files, JSONL/Parquet rows and `Task(...)` objects; see [tasks.md](tasks.md).

### `Task`

Complete task definition for sandbox seeding and agent rollout.

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | str | **required** | Unique id (used in file and container names). |
| `description` | str | **required** | What the agent must do (the default user prompt). |
| `prompt` | str \| None | `None` | User prompt template; {description} and {files} are substituted |
| `starter_files` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Workspace-relative path -> text content. |
| `binary_files` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | path -> base64 content for non-text starter files |
| `setup_commands` | list[str] | `[]` | Run after seeding, before the agent (snapshotted into cached images). |
| `verifier` | VerifierSpec | **required** | How the outcome is measured. |
| `environment` | EnvironmentSpec \| None | `None` | Per-task sandbox overrides. |
| `metadata` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Free-form; copied into trajectories. |
| `system_prompt_extra` | str \| None | `None` | Appended to the system prompt. |
| `allowed_tools` | list[str] \| None | `None` | Restrict the tool set for this task. |
| `max_steps` | int \| None | `None` | Override AgentConfig.max_steps. |
| `episode_timeout_s` | float \| None | `None` | Override AgentConfig.episode_timeout_s. |
| `split` | 'train' \| 'eval' \| 'test' \| None | `None` | Dataset split (iter_tasks(split=...), `run --split`). |
| `group_key` | str \| None | `None` | Label shared by variants of one problem; copied into trajectories. |
| `version` | str \| None | `None` | Task revision (part of task_hash). |

### `VerifierSpec`

How the outcome of an episode is measured (ground truth for reward).

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | VerifierType | `'command'` | pytest \| command \| custom (test/shell aliases). |
| `command` | str \| None | `None` | Shell command run in the workspace (pytest: default pytest -q). |
| `path` | str \| None | `None` | pytest only: test path when no command is given. |
| `success_exit_code` | int | `0` | Exit code that counts as success. |
| `timeout_s` | float | `60.0` | Verifier command timeout. |
| `reward_success` | float | `1.0` | Reward on success (binary mode). |
| `reward_failure` | float | `0.0` | Reward on failure (binary mode). |
| `reward_mode` | 'binary' \| 'pytest_fraction' \| 'stdout' \| 'custom' | `'binary'` | binary: success/failure reward; pytest_fraction: interpolate by passed/total tests (JUnit XML); stdout: last stdout line is a float or JSON {'reward': x}; custom: reward_fn (dotted path) computes the reward |
| `parse_stdout` | bool | `False` | Deprecated alias of reward_mode=stdout |
| `reward_fn` | str \| None | `None` | 'package.module:function' for reward_mode=custom |
| `success_threshold` | float \| None | `None` | If set, success means reward >= threshold |
| `env` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Extra environment for the verifier command. |
| `workdir` | str \| None | `None` | cwd for the verifier (default: workspace). |
| `pre_commands` | list[str] | `[]` | Run before the verifier command (not scored) |
| `hidden_files` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Never shown to the agent; written right before verification |
| `protected_paths` | list[str] | `[]` | Globs of starter files restored before verification; edits are flagged |
| `forbid_new_files` | list[str] | `[]` | Globs (e.g. PYTEST_TAMPER_FILES) the agent may not create; deleted + flagged |
| `on_tamper` | 'fail' \| 'flag' | `'fail'` | fail: tampering scores tamper_reward and is not a success; flag: record only. |
| `tamper_reward` | float \| None | `None` | Reward when tampering is detected (default reward_failure) |
| `hardened` | bool | `True` | Clean pytest env (PYTEST_ADDOPTS, user site) and disable cache provider |

### `EnvironmentSpec`

Per-task sandbox overrides merged over the run's SandboxConfig (GH #25).

| field | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | str \| None | `None` | Image for this task's sandboxes. |
| `env` | dict[str, str] | `{}` | Environment merged over SandboxConfig.env. |
| `network` | bool \| None | `None` | Allow network for this task. |
| `cpu_count` | float \| None | `None` | CPU limit override. |
| `memory_mb` | int \| None | `None` | Memory limit override (MiB). |
| `working_dir` | str \| None | `None` | Workspace and cwd for this task's sandboxes. |
| `ensure_pytest` | bool \| None | `None` | Override ensure_pytest. |
